title: Design Lock-In & Content Strategy
format: Video call — design walkthrough + content workflow
tldr: Working call (Justin + Brandon) that locked the design layout & style and moved the project into the content phase. Top Rock walked the latest site version (built from Brandon's round-2 color/layout feedback); Brandon approved the flow — lead with what he does, then conditions, then story, services/packages, email capture, and reviews at the bottom. The team agreed a content-iteration workflow: Top Rock ships the live site → Brandon drops screenshots + copy edits into a shared Google Doc → Top Rock uses AI to organize the feedback and ship revisions, async. They scoped a conditions page (modeled loosely on his mentor Dr. Bueller's info-dense page) for SEO + educating considering patients, with AI drafting ~65% of the copy for Brandon to refine. Brandon defined his brand voice (professional, honest, integrity, truth — clinical experience + literature, but not prescriptive or arrogant; kill the "true aligned practitioner" line). He still needs professional photos, a logo, and Google/Yelp reviews set up. Hosting decided: domain on GoDaddy, point it to Top Rock's Vercel hosting (off Duda). Lots of bigger ideas parked (patient PDF reports/case studies, a mobility app, dropping Jane App). Brandon's in town week of July 13 for a lunch.

actionItems.action: Review the shipped site; send screenshots + copy edits via the shared Google Doc.
Get a round of professional photos (candids, headshots, lifestyle).
Set up Google Business + Yelp and start collecting reviews.
Handle the DBA / legal name change.
Ship the live site to Brandon for copy review.
Build the conditions page and AI-draft the copy (~65%) for Brandon to refine.
Tune copy to Brandon's voice; remove "true aligned practitioner."
Set up Vercel hosting and point the GoDaddy domain to it.
Schedule the July lunch (week of July 13) — meet in person.
